chapter: Tulsa bands, Trent, Holder and Kirk
title: Declining to go on the road with Butterbeans and Susie
summary: Though he worked the whole season, he turned down touring with vaudeville shows, recalling how Basie got stranded.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So you didn't get the opportunity to back Butterbeans and Susie?
Oh, I worked that whole season.
Oh, did you work with them?
Oh yeah I did, he had me wrapped in but he wanted me to go and travel with him.
He wanted you to go on the road.

Yeah, but when I looked over things, I kind of felt, I got my job here, I've been playing on the side and--you're young, Preston, but you know those vaudeville shows were bad, that's how Basie got stranded here in Oklahoma and Kansas--and I just figured I didn't want to start out doing like that. I saw they were way over me as far
as music but now if they're so much over me and you have to live like that, well I just couldn't see it and I didn't go.
